description: The bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy (measured as instilled preferences) for a model identified as “GPT-4o-mini” under three experimental conditions: “Control,” “Before Introspection Training,” and “After Introspection Training.” The vertical axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences),” ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 in increments of 0.25. The horizontal axis contains a single category labeled “GPT-4o-mini,” under which three bars are grouped. The “Control” condition is represented by a light gray bar with a value approximately 0.15, accompanied by error bars extending from roughly 0.05 to 0.25. The “Before Introspection Training” condition is shown as a light blue bar with a value near 0.55, with error bars spanning approximately 0.45 to 0.65. The “After Introspection Training” condition is depicted by a dark purple bar reaching approximately 0.75, with error bars ranging from about 0.65 to 0.85. A second, nearly invisible gray bar (likely representing a second control or baseline) appears to the right of the main group, with a value near 0.00 and large error bars extending below zero and up to approximately 0.10. The chart visually suggests that self-report accuracy improves significantly after introspection training compared to both the control and pre-training states, with the post-training condition showing the highest accuracy and the control condition the lowest.
